questions.question: When a number is divided by 63 the remainder is obtained as 26. What will be the remainder when the number is divided by 3?
questions.solution:
Let x and q be the number and quotient respectively so, we can write

⇒ x = 63q + 26

⇒ x = (3 × 21q) + (3 × 8) + 2

⇒ x = 3(21q + 8) + 2

∴ When the number is divided by 3, the remainder is 2

If four angles of a quadrilateral are (6x - 18), (80 - 4x), (4x + 14), (12x - 58), then find the value of the smallest angle of the quadrilateral.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **sum of interior angles** of any **quadrilateral** is always 360°.

Combine **x-terms**: 6x − 4x + 4x + 12x = 18x.

Combine **constants**: −18 + 80 + 14 − 58 = 18.

Setting 18x + 18 = 360° gives x = (360 − 18) ÷ 18 = 19.

Testing for the **smallest angle**: 80 − 4(19) = 80 − 76 = 4°.

**∴ The correct answer is 4°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The four **angles** of the **quadrilateral** are (6x − 18), (80 − 4x), (4x + 14), and (12x − 58).

**Formula Used:** Sum of all **internal angles** of a **quadrilateral** = 360°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3304d8397c1497c0bcc8d8ef369549c6535dd06e25ff8dcbdcd2609cca7123e1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (6x − 18) + (80 − 4x) + (4x + 14) + (12x − 58) = 360°

⇒ 18x + 18 = 360°

⇒ 18x = 360 − 18 = 342°

⇒ x = 342 ÷ 18 = 19

Calculating the value of each **angle**:

⇒ 1st Angle = 6(19) − 18 = 114 − 18 = 96°

⇒ 2ⁿd Angle = 80 − 4(19) = 80 − 76 = 4°

⇒ 3rd Angle = 4(19) + 14 = 76 + 14 = 90°

⇒ 4th Angle = 12(19) − 58 = 228 − 58 = 170°

Comparing the values, the **smallest angle** is 4°.

**∴ The correct answer is 4°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle Sum Property of Polygons

The sum of **interior angles** of a **polygon** with n sides is given by the formula (n − 2) × 180°. For a **quadrilateral** (n=4), the sum is (4 − 2) × 180° = 360°.

Types of Quadrilaterals

In a **convex quadrilateral**, all **interior angles** are less than 180°. If one angle is greater than 180°, it is known as a **concave quadrilateral**.

Cyclic Quadrilateral

A **quadrilateral** whose all four vertices lie on a **circle** is called **cyclic**. In such a case, the sum of **opposite angles** is always 180°.</p

questions.question: If A is 50% more than B, then B is what percent of A?
questions.solution:
Let the value of B be 100

⇒ Value of A = 100 + 50% of 100 = 100 + 50 = 150

∴ Required % = (100/150) × 100 = 66.66%

questions.question: The ratio of incomes of C and D is 3 : 2. Ratio of income of D and E is 5 : 4. If one-third of C’s income is Rs. 4000 more than the half of E’s income, then what is D’s income (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Ratio of income of C and D = 3 ∶ 2 = 15 ∶ 10

Also,

Ratio of income of D and E = 5 ∶ 4 = 10 ∶ 8

Let income of C, D and E be 15x, 10x and 8x respectively

According to the question

⇒ (1/3) of 15x = (1/2) of 8x + 4000

⇒ 5x = 4x + 4000

⇒ x = 4000

∴ D’s income = 10x = 10 × 4000 = 40,000

questions.question: A, B and C start a business and the ratio of their investment is 8 : 5 : 3. If at the end the ratio of their profits is 4 : 15 : 6, then what is the ratio of time period of their investment?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of A,B,C = 8 : 5 : 3

**Concept used:**

Profit = investment × time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time = profit/investment

Given,

⇒ Ratio of their profit = 4 ∶ 15 ∶ 6

⇒ Ratio of their investment = 8 ∶ 5 ∶ 3

∴ Time = (4/8) : (15/5) : (6/3) = (1/2) : 3 : 2 = 1 : 6 : 4

questions.question: Of the 5 subjects, the average marks of Rakesh in first 3 Subjects was 79 and the average marks in the last 3 subjects was 86. If his marks in the third subject were 80, then what were his average marks in all the 5 subjects?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average marks in first 3 subjects = 79

Average marks in last 3 subjects = 86

**Concept used:**

Average = sum of all observations/number of observations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Average marks of Rakesh in first 3 subjects = 79

⇒ Sum of marks in first 3 subjects = 79 × 3 = 237

Also,

Average marks of Rakesh in last 3 subjects = 86

⇒ Sum of marks in last 3 subjects = 86 × 3 = 258

Marks in third subject = 80

Sum of marks in all the five subjects = 237 + 258 - 80 = 415

∴ Average of all the five subjects = 415/5 = 83

questions.question: A certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 15 years at a rate of simple interest. In how many years will it become 5 times of itself at the same rate of simple interest?
questions.solution:
Let the principal be x

Amount after 15 years = 2x

Principal + simple interest = 2x

⇒ x + simple interest = 2x

⇒ Simple interest = x

⇒ (Principal × rate × time)/100 = x

⇒ (x × rate × 15)/100 = x

⇒ Rate = 100/15 = (20/3)%

Now,

Amount = 5x

⇒ Principal + simple interest = 5x

⇒ x + simple interest = 5x

⇒ Simple interest = 4x

⇒ (Principal × rate × time)/100 = 4x

⇒ {x × (20/3) × time}/100 = 4x

∴ Time = 60 years

questions.question: Ramesh sells an article at a loss of 5%. If he buys it for 30% less price and sells it for Rs. 38.5 less, then his profit will be 20%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Loss = 5% 

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of an article be 100x

SP of the article = cost price - loss% of cost price = 100x - 5% of 100x = 95x

⇒ New CP of the article = 100x - 30% of 100x = 100x - 30x = 70x

⇒ New SP of the article = 70x + 20% of 70x = 70x + 14x = 84x

According to the question

⇒ 84x = 95x - 38.5

⇒ 11x = 38.5

⇒ x = 3.5

∴ **CP of the article = 100 × 3.5 = 350**

questions.question: If the ratio of marked price and selling price is 11 : 10, then what is the discount percentage?
questions.solution:
Marked price/selling price = 11/10

⇒ Selling price/Marked price = 10/11

∴ Discount % = {(MP - SP)/MP} × 100 = {1 - (SP/MP)} × 100 = {1 - (10/11)} × 100 = 9.09%

questions.question: Robin can do a work in 10 hours. Pradeep and Robin together can do the same work in 4 hours. Pradeep and Nitin together can do the same work in 5 hours. In how many hours will Nitin complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Time taken by Robin alone to do a work = 10 hrs

Time taken by Pradeep and Robin together to do the same work = 4 hrs

Work done by Rrobin in 1 hr = 1/10

Work done by Rrobin and Pradeep in 1 hr = 1/4

Work done by Pradeep in 1 hr = (1/4) - (1/10) = 3/20

Now,

Time taken by Pradeep and Nitin together to do the same work = 5 hrs

Work done by Pradeep and Nitin in 1 hr = 1/5

Work done by Nitin in 1 hr = (1/5) - (3/20) = 1/20

∴ Nitin can complete the same work in 20 hrs

questions.question: Two trains move from stations M and N respectively. Both trains move towards each other at speeds of 54 km/hr and 63 km/hr respectively. When they meet each other, the second train has travelled 100 km more than the first. What is the distance (in km) between M and N?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the trains = 54 km/hr and 63 km/hr

Concept used:

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Let both the train meet each other in x hrs

Speed difference = 63 - 54 = 9 km/hr

According to the question,

⇒ (63 - 54)x = 100

⇒ x = 100/9 hr

Now,

Relative speed = 63 + 54 = 117

Time⇒ X = 100/9

Distance = speed × Time

∴ Total distance between M and N = 63x + 54x = 117x = 117 × (100/9) = 1300 km

questions.question: The area of a circle is 38.5 cm². Find its circumference (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of circle = 38.5 cm²

**Calculation:**

Area of circle = πr²

⇒ πr² = 38.5

⇒ (22/7) × r² = 38.5

⇒ r² = 12.25

⇒ r = 3.5

Now,

∴ Circumference of circle = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 3.5 = 22 cm

questions.solution:

Height of cylinder = 14 cm

Diameter of cylinder = 42 cm

**Calculation:**

Radius of cylinder = diameter/2 = 42/2 = 21 cm

Now,

∴ Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 14 = 1848 cm²
